_comment: MOCK RUNTIME SCENARIO, not live output. Pins agent results in scripts/workflow_dryrun.mjs to the shape the synthetic fixture should produce, for mock-derived agent counts and the checker tests. Says nothing about live model behaviour.

return.design: non-randomized two-section quasi-experiment; independent-samples t-test on final-exam scores

return.summary: A classroom comparison of weekly quizzing and re-reading in two statistics sections.

concerns.issue: Sections were not randomized and had different instructors, so instructor is confounded with condition.
concerns.quote: Section A was taught by Instructor 1 and Section B by Instructor 2
concerns.suggested_fix: Model instructor/section or temper the causal language.

concerns.quote: graded by teaching assistants who knew each student's section
concerns.suggested_fix: Re-grade a blinded subsample or report inter-rater agreement.

concerns.issue: Prior GPA was collected but not used as a covariate.

return.summary: The central causal and generalization claims outrun a single two-section comparison.

concerns.issue: The abstract says quizzing caused the higher scores, which the non-randomized design cannot support.
concerns.quote: Weekly quizzing caused the higher exam scores

concerns.issue: Generalization to every STEM course is unsupported by one statistics course.
concerns.quote: the effect will generalize to every STEM course

return.reason: the manuscript does not address this
